definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for physical exercise, sports, or other active purposes.

examples.japanese: {運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: We wear gym clothes during PE class at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かいた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Since I had sweated, I put my gym clothes in the laundry.

notes:
⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (exercise, sports) + {着|ぎ} (clothing). A general term for clothing worn during physical activity. In school contexts, it often refers specifically to the standard PE uniform (white shirt and shorts or track pants).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧ — change into sportswear
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ — wear sportswear
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ — wash sportswear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{体操着|たいそうぎ}→体操着：24194_taisougi⟧ — PE clothes — specifically the gym uniform worn at school
- {体操服|たいそうふく} — PE clothes — another common term for school gym uniforms
- ジャージ — jersey; tracksuit — casual sportswear, often worn outside of exercise
- ウエア — (sports) wear — loanword used in retail and fashion contexts
